purpose: API-served models for the local-cognition decision battery. Adding a model here is the ONLY edit needed to include it in an api_provider_eval run.
billing_note: cohort records how a call is paid for, because on Cerebras the two products bill differently: 'trial-credit' draws down a finite $5 one-time grant, 'subscription-exempt' does NOT consume PayGo credits, 'renewable' is a free plan that resets daily.
key_source: environment first, then the `refs:` block of ~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml (loaded in-process; values are never printed or passed on argv)

groq.limits_note: free plan: 30 RPM, 8000 TPM, 200000 TPD. TPM binds first — one ~6k-token call fills a minute.
groq.dialect_note: hammer = tool_choice 'auto', 384-token completion budget, parses BOTH native tool_calls and bare JSON content. Required because these models intermittently answer with JSON content instead of a tool_call: under tool_choice='required' that is an HTTP 400 'tool_use_failed' on Groq, which the adapter would record as an abstention. 'qwen'/'hermes' cap output at 1024/256 and both demand a native call.
groq.base_url_note: Host root only. The transport appends '/v1/chat/completions' itself, so a base_url ending in /v1 produces /v1/v1/chat/completions and a 404.

cerebras.limits_note: Free Trial: 5 RPM, 30K uncached / 90K total TPM, 1M TPH, 1M TPD. Consumes a finite $5 grant that expires 30 days after issue. Cached tokens do not count against uncached TPM.
